bowl.reason_en: Bowling resources are unremarkable, without a clearly defined tactical identity yet.

fld.reason_zh: 守備水準中規中矩，基本功尚屬穩健。
fld.reason_en: Fielding is middle-of-the-road, with solid if unremarkable fundamentals.

fin.reason_zh: 終結能力普通，關鍵局表現有待觀察。

frm.reason_zh: 近期戰績持平，缺乏明顯的上升或下滑趨勢。
frm.reason_en: Recent form has been flat, without a clear upward or downward trend.
